captions.facebook:
Big deductible? Compare before you book your scan. 🧮

A deductible is the amount you pay for covered care before your insurance plan starts to pay (HealthCare.gov). If you haven't met it yet, you may pay your plan's full rate for an MRI or CT yourself, and hospital MRIs in Florida often run $1,200 to $3,500 once facility fees are added.

Our self-pay prices are published up front, with the radiologist's reading included and no facility fees:
✔️ MRI $295 ($395 with and without contrast), Seminole and St. Petersburg
✔️ CT $295 ($395 with and without contrast), Seminole
✔️ Routine ultrasound $195, Seminole
✔️ No referral and no prior authorization for eligible self-pay exams
✔️ HSA and FSA cards accepted

Before you book, ask your plan:
1. How much of my deductible is left?
2. What would I owe for this exam in network?
3. Does a self-pay scan count toward my deductible?
4. Is prior authorization needed, and how long will it take?

Already met your deductible? Insurance may be the better deal. We accept most plans and verify your benefits for free, so we can help you compare.

📅 Book online: https://www.advancedimg.com/lp/imaging-seminole-fl?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=deductible-faq
📞 Or call (727) 398-5999 (Mon to Fri, 8 to 5)
📍 Seminole and St. Petersburg

Know someone with a big deductible? Share this with them.

General information, not medical or financial advice. Your plan's rules apply. Self-pay prices as of November 2026. Hospital range is typical Florida hospital outpatient pricing, not a quote for any one hospital. Using Medicare or Medicaid? Ask us what applies.

facts_checked: Checked 2026-11-10. Check your plan details.'
